remarks:
Welcome to 21 Stoneman in the Village of Lakewood! This beautifully maintained and pristine home offers comfortable one-floor living with the added bonus of a spacious loft overlooking the living area, creating wonderful additional space for a home office, family room, guest area, or whatever suits your needs.
Featuring 4 bedrooms and 1½ baths, this home has been thoughtfully updated with all new flooring and fresh paint throughout, along with custom blinds in the bedrooms and living room. The first-floor laundry adds convenience, while the bright and inviting living spaces make this home truly move-in ready.
Enjoy the outdoors from the spacious back deck with awning, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A newly added privacy fence completely encloses the backyard, providing a wonderful private outdoor space.
The oversized two-car garage offers exceptional flexibility and storage. With the ability to lower the garage door privacy screen, the garage can even be transformed into additional living or entertaining space when desired. Located in the desirable Village of Lakewood and within the Southwestern School District, this property also offers access to the Stoneman Dock Association, adding to its appeal for those who enjoy the Lakewood and Chautauqua Lake lifestyle. This pristine, move-in-ready home combines the convenience of one-floor living with the versatility of loft space, a private backyard, generous outdoor living, and an oversized garage. A wonderful opportunity in the Village of Lakewood!
